routeA_reading.between_minus4_and_2: Even roots strictly between -4 and 2 reduce to the l=0 pair alpha=0,-2; l=1 pair alpha=1,-3 is odd and absent. Alpha=-1 is not a scalar-harmonic Cartesian root in this model.
routeA_reading.volume_gauge: The l=0 regular mode is linear-coordinate/dilation gauge at the cone; its dual r^-2 is the mass/volume mode. Step 30 found EH has no r^-2 mass term, so this pair is removed for the A1/EH channel after fixing cone/volume gauge.
routeA_reading.dominant_pair: The first remaining even geometric pair is l=2 and l=-4: orbifold curvature 2-jet H2 against the Eguchi-Hanson r^-4 coefficient H4, with radius-independent Wronskian signal of order t^4.
routeA_reading.caveat: This finite flat-cone computation must still be matched to the full tensor spherical-harmonic/weighted Bianchi setup and to nonlinear annular harmonic-radius control; it is strong evidence for what to compute next, not a theorem of Route A.
